content.title: [FR] FR-030 主管确认、发布与归档
content.body:
## 需求
范围：P0；关联流程：BP-07；页面：PG-09；开始提供：R7；完整提供：R7。
前置功能：FR-025/026/037。
• 计划员提交，主管查看规则检查、未排需求、预计供给条件及调整原因后确认或退回。确认后内容保存，供本系统查询和导出。
• 输入或方案发生影响结果的变化后需重新提交。允许确认已排部分时，必须明确未排清单；存在已启用规则冲突时不能确认发布。不连接外部执行系统。

## 验收追踪
验收用例：AC-22/23/24/32。

来源：需求分析与设计说明书 v0.3，第 6 章；状态：基线需求，具体实现状态待跟踪。


## Patrol delivery and immediate continuation
Owner APS-Dev; delivery dlv_e2892c09-5b67-4de2-8f20-8a98a6f4d5c3. Immediately assigned after FR029 completion; Dev idle with no active/queued duplicate, open issues scanned no confirmed unresolved product defect. FR025/026/037 source prerequisites available in a5fa26da552b7d8f4196eb93a6618652648cd50f. Original AC22/23/24/32 planner submit/supervisor return-confirm/recheck/release/archive and immutable query/export assigned. Enabled-rule conflicts prohibit confirmation; stale changes require resubmission; partial acceptance requires explicit unplanned list. Trusted server roles/audit/current-fact protection, meaningful container tests/build, ordinary push/fullSHA/report/limits required. Existing issues10/13 acceptance gaps remain open; no fullDone inferred or parallel card.


## FR030 platform failure and immediate recovery
Prior delivery dlv_e2892c09-5b67-4de2-8f20-8a98a6f4d5c3 failed before delivery: Selected model is at capacity. Please try a different model. (server_overloaded). No pushed completion accepted. Dev was idle with no waiting/executing queue. Reassigned SAME canonical FR030 to owner APS-Dev, recovery delivery dlv_26004688-33b0-4447-aa03-3963c2db8180. Inspect partial work and resume original AC22/23/24/32 scope, ordinary push/fullSHA/tests/build/report required. In progress; runtime/model capacity blocker is not a confirmed product defect and consumes no repair round. Existing workflow acceptance issue https://github.com/huiliangtao666/APS/issues/10 remains open. Test continues FR029 independently under dlv_0a88a2de-840e-4d5f-a5c3-e38f13fb1e62; no duplicate dispatch or parallel backlog.
